description: This file defines a Swift class 'TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer' that provides an asynchronous text-to-speech (TTS) service using AVFoundation's AVSpeechSynthesizer. It manages speech synthesis, including timeout handling, start/stop controls, and delegate methods to manage speech events.

classes.name: TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer
classes.description: A singleton class managing speech synthesis with timeout, start, stop, and delegate callback handling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech, cancels watchdog, and resets state.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Performs asynchronous speech synthesis of provided text with optional language and onStart callback.

methods.name: watchdogTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Calculates a timeout duration based on the language and length of the text.
